HelpStep1Text: Start typing make, model or year in the search box — the list auto-filters. Select a car from the list: make, model and year fill automatically. The ↻ button refreshes the car database from the server. The 🗑 button clears the database and spec cache — requires reload. The ✕ button clears the selection.
HelpStep1Note: If your car isn't in the database, just type make, model and year manually in the fields below. The database refreshes on startup and is cached locally.
HelpStep2Text: Fill in MASS & BALANCE (total mass + front weight distribution %). In the ENGINE section, set powertrain type (ICE / Hybrid / Electric), power, torque, max RPM, engine type and position, aspiration, fuel type and anti-lag.
HelpStep2Note: In TRANSMISSION, set drive type and gear count. Check 'Calculate gear ratios' to compute gear steps; 'Final drive only' calculates just the final drive. Diesel gets short first gear and tight spacing due to its narrow power band.
HelpStep3Text: In TIRES & WHEELS, set front and rear tire width, profile, rim diameter, and tire type — these affect pressure and stiffness calculations.
HelpStep3Note: Click 'AI: fetch specs' to auto-fill wheelbase, track, Cd and frontal area. Estimated values are marked with ⚠ — verify before generating. In the UPGRADES section, choose suspension, differential and brake upgrade levels — they shift parameter ranges.
HelpStep4Text: Set allowed ranges for springs (min/max front and rear), ride height (min/max front and rear) and center differential bias (AWD). The generator stays within these limits. Spring and ride height sections are only visible with sufficient suspension upgrade level. Center diff bias is only available for All-Wheel Drive.
HelpStep4Note: For aero, check 'Front / Rear aero kit installed' — min/max downforce fields appear. If no aero, uncheck and leave fields empty.
HelpStep5Text: In the Discipline tab, choose: Road, Touge, Drift, Drag, Rally, Cross Country, Eliminator or Street. Each discipline uses its own stiffness, geometry and gear ratio formulas. For drag, also set distance (⅛, ¼, ½ mile or mile).
HelpStep5Note: Click ⚡ Generate at the bottom. Or check ✓ Auto in the right panel header — the tune auto-recalculates on any data change (~400 ms debounce).
HelpStep6Text: The right panel shows all tune parameters:
HelpStep7Text: In Drag mode, a Launch Control block appears above the main parameters with optimal launch RPM. Hold throttle at this RPM before the green light. Calculation accounts for aspiration type, torque peak, drive type and fuel type: diesel gets lower launch RPM due to early torque peak.
HelpStep8Text: 💾 Save stores car data, constraints and tune. The name is auto-generated from make, model, year, drive type, engine type and discipline. Select a profile from the list to load immediately. + New resets all fields. 🗑 deletes the selected profile.
HelpStep8Note: Units and language toggle in the top bar: Metric / Imperial, power in HP / PS / kW, spring rate in N/mm · kgf/mm · lb/in. Interface language: Русский / English. All internal calculations use metric — conversion is for display only.
HelpStep6Line1: • TIRE PRESSURE — front and rear in bar / PSI
HelpStep6Line2: • WHEEL ALIGNMENT — camber front/rear, caster, toe front/rear
HelpStep6Line4: • SPRINGS + RIDE HEIGHT — stiffness and height front/rear
HelpStep6Line7: • DIFFERENTIAL — accel/decel + center diff and front diff (AWD)
HelpStep6Line9: • GEARING — final drive, estimated max speed, gear ratios
HelpStep6Line10: Hover over any value — tooltip explains the physics. The gear chart below shows speed range per gear; vertical lines mark peak power (orange) and peak torque (blue).
Expl_TirePressureReason_Drag: Drag: neutral front (~32 PSI), min rear (~18-20 PSI) for max launch grip.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Drift: Drift: ~25 PSI front / ~22 PSI rear for predictable sliding.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Rally: Rally/CC: lower pressure for maximum contact patch.
Expl_TirePressureReason_CrossCountry: Rally/CC: lower pressure for maximum contact patch.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Touge: Touge: slightly softer than base for mountain road grip.
Expl_TirePressureReason_Street: Street: standard pressure with slight rear margin for maneuvers.
Expl_CamberReason_Drag: Drag: minimal camber — maximum contact patch at launch.
Expl_CamberReason_Drift: Drift: aggressive front camber for control at high steering angles.
Expl_CamberReason_Rally: Rally: moderate camber — flat contact patch on gravel.
Expl_CamberReason_CrossCountry: CC: minimal camber — maximum contact on bumps.
Expl_CamberReason_Touge: Touge: increased camber for precise corner entry on tight turns.
Expl_CamberReason_Road: Road: classic negative camber to compensate for body roll in corners.
Expl_ARBNote_Drag: Drag: min front for weight transfer; stiff rear for platform.
Expl_ARBNote_DriftRWD: Drift: soft front for initiation; moderate rear for angle hold (ForzaFire R20-25).
Expl_ARBNote_Rally: Rally: soft for independent wheel travel on gravel.
Expl_ARBNote_CrossCountry: CC: min stiffness for suspension articulation.
Expl_ARBNote_TougeRWD: Touge RWD: stiffer for precise control.
Expl_ARBNote_TougeFWD: Touge FWD: soft front for grip, stiff rear for rotation.
Expl_ARBNote_StreetFWD: Street FWD: soft front for grip, stiffer rear against understeer.
Expl_ARBNote_RoadRWD: Road RWD: front stiffer than rear for precise entry (ForzaFire F18-28/R12-20).
Expl_ARBNote_RoadFWD: Road FWD: soft front (grip), stiffer rear (rotation).
Expl_ARBNote_RoadAWD: Road AWD: F26/R33 — balanced ARBs (ForzaFire F22-30/R28-38).

Expl_RideHeightNote_Drag: Drag: min clearance for aero, low CG; slight rear rake for weight transfer at launch.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Drift: Drift: low ride height for stability in slides.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Rally: Rally: high clearance for uneven terrain.
Expl_RideHeightNote_CrossCountry: CC: max clearance for jumps and bumps.
Expl_RideHeightNote_Road: Road: min clearance for low CG.
